title: a16z Podcast: The Product Edge in Machine Learning Startups

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: A lot of machine learning startups initially feel a bit of “impostor syndrome” around competing with big companies.
reader_summary.overview: A lot of machine learning startups initially feel a bit of “impostor syndrome” around competing with big companies, because (the argument goes). Yet there are many ways startups can, and do, successfully compete with big companies. You can actually achieve great results in a lot of areas even with a relatively small data set, argue the guests on this podcast.

key_points.text: A lot of machine learning startups initially feel a bit of “impostor syndrome” around competing with big companies, because (the argument goes).
You can actually achieve great results in a lot of areas even with a relatively small data set, argue the guests on this podcast.
So how do you go about building the right product (beyond machine-learning algorithms in academic papers)?
